The European Commission will meet with the parties in a "state-of-play" meeting, according to traders who cited a Capitol Forum report that was circulating on Friday. The regulator hasn't decided if it will open a phase 2 probe into the combination, and it could still cancel the meeting.
The meeting is taking place as some European supermarkets and retailers are concerned the combined company would control too many big brands, according to the report.
